references.story: Use case: ui-mockup. Using the attached FORM hero solely as the brand/art-direction reference, create a NEW standalone website SECOND SECTION design, landscape 16:10, flat frontal high-fidelity desktop screenshot, no browser or device. This is NOT a new hero and not an edit of the first image. Exact FORM visual DNA: warm off-white paper #e9e6dd, black ink, vermilion #ef4b25, exceptionally bold tightly condensed Cyrillic typography, sports editorial aesthetic. Section purpose: explain that a short training session fits into an ordinary day. Top small section label «01 / ТВОЙ РИТМ». Composition: asymmetrical open editorial grid. Very large three-line left headline «МЕЖДУ ДЕЛОМ.\nДЛЯ СЕБЯ.» takes upper left, readable and strong. On right a sharply art-directed black-and-white macro photo of worn running sneakers tied with laces, cropped like an independent sports magazine, crisp paper grain, diagonal narrow orange strip across edge. Bottom left restrained paragraph: «Не обязательно освобождать вечер. Начни с десяти минут — дома или на улице, без оборудования.» Bottom center/right three plain typographic facts separated by hairline rules, not cards: «10–30 / минут на движение», «2 / места для старта», «0 / лишнего оборудования». These are product specifications, not user success metrics. Nice negative space, strong strict baseline grid, text large and readable, generous padding. Small text link lower left «Найти время для себя ↗». Do not include header navigation, feature card grids, rounded containers, charts, testimonials, fake metrics, decorative AI terminology or pricing. Main typography must be live-code-friendly and independent of the photography. Only this one explanatory section, not whole page.
